description:
Run a strategy backtest and render its equity curve as an
interactive chart in the conversation (capital growth + drawdown,
with return / win-rate / Sharpe stats). Strategies: rsi, bollinger,
macd, ema_cross, supertrend, donchian, rsi_pullback,
keltner_breakout, triple_ema. period: 1mo|3mo|6mo|1y|2y,
interval: 1d|1h. Clients without interactive app support can read
the `summary` field.
name: backtest_chart
title: Backtest Equity Curve
